x-card.description: Collections and points of Qdrant and Qdrant Cloud: filtered pages, nearest-neighbour search by vector or point. Upserts and deletes wait for approval.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Qdrant's REST address with https:// and its port (6333 by default), optionally with a path prefix. Plain http:// only to this computer.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: The collections agents may use; * matches any characters, such as docs_*. Empty: every collection the credentials see.

method.title: Authentication
method.description: No authentication only for a server that checks no key, never on prod.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. Prefer Qdrant's read-only API key, or a JWT that may only read the collections agents use.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: A private CA. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a server whose certificate comes from a private CA.
